vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: vikunja-task-api
Version: 2.0.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate integration for the Vikunja task management system. The bash script (vikunja.sh) and instructions (SKILL.md) correctly implement API interactions for project and task management using standard environment variables for authentication (VIKUNJA_TOKEN/USERNAME/PASSWORD). No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements, instructions, and included shell helper are consistent with its stated purpose of interacting with a Vikunja server via its API and do not request unrelated credentials or perform unexpected actions.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the requested capabilities: curl+jq and VIKUNJA_URL/VIKUNJA_TOKEN are exactly what a Vikunja API helper needs. Optional VIKUNJA_USERNAME/VIKUNJA_PASSWORD are justified as a fallback to obtain a JWT.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and vikunja.sh only call the Vikunja API endpoints (under $VIKUNJA_URL/api/v1), handle authentication via token or login, and perform task/project CRUD operations. There are no instructions to read unrelated files, system secrets, or to transmit data to external endpoints other than the configured VIKUNJA_URL.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only plus a small helper script). No downloads or third-party package installs — lowest-risk install profile. Required binaries are common (curl, jq).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Required env vars are minimal and proportional: VIKUNJA_URL is required; VIKUNJA_TOKEN is the primary credential; username/password are optional fallbacks. No unrelated secrets or broad permissions are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system-wide changes or access other skills' configs. It will run only when invoked (or when the agent autonomously chooses to call it, which is the platform default).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it says: a thin CLI/instruction wrapper around the Vikunja HTTP API. Before installing, confirm the VIKUNJA_URL points to a server you control/trust and use a least-privileged API token rather than full admin credentials when possible. Treat VIKUNJA_TOKEN like any secret: store it securely (the SKILL.md suggests a secure env file) and avoid pasting it into public logs. If you want extra assurance, inspect or run the included vikunja.sh locally in a restricted environment to confirm behavior. Note: the agent may call this skill autonomously if allowed by your agent settings — that is normal but means the agent could perform operations on your Vikunja instance without further prompts, so consider access controls around the token.
